lines: Perumal Ramamurthy Srinivasan may receive up to ₹0.91 crore if all offered shares are sold; actual proceeds are slightly lower due to employee-portion discount.
Gain is up to ₹0.67 crore before offer expenses and taxes, from selling up to 6,750 shares.
Money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago); the trigger, shares unlocked 9 Sep 2026, is 66 days ago.
Retained value is an estimate of ₹2.13 crore at offer price; the holder is a named Investor Selling Shareholder.
